scope: Adopt the physics-correctness work started before the lease bootstrap: shared Slang rotational/contact corrections, common static mesh feature classification, and their CUDA/D3D12 numerical compilation contract. Resolve the selected 10/17 comparison failures and shared eight-brick penetration failure. acceptance: All 17 selected same-build CUDA/D3D12 comparisons pass, with zero unsupported cases and unchanged canonical inputs, numerical tolerances and historical goldens.
Both adapters pass the independent eight-brick, four-substep, 300-frame mesh-penetration check against its existing 2 mm limit.

D3D12 passes all 13 supported gallery scene/reset gates, the 2400-frame hinge/slider fixture, repeated API submissions and resource/domain/coupling lifecycle checks; the installed gallery survives each supported scene for at least five seconds.

Commit a scoped, revisioned evidence report with reproduction commands, device/toolchain and case hashes. No backend-specific physics fork, tolerance relaxation, full-domain qualification or performance claim.
